title: Kumo Kagyu's Moscow 2160 Manga Listed to End With 5th Volume
content:
Amazon Japan is listing the fifth compiled book volume of Kumo Kagyu and artist Kōtarō Sekine 's Moscow 2160 manga as the end for the series. The volume ships on December 25.

Yen Press p ublishes the manga and light novel in English and describes the story:

In the near future of a world whose history diverges from our own, the Soviet Union remains intact and the Cold War has continued for two centuries. Cyborg thieves and rogues roam the streets, and the powers that be conspire in secret… In the far north city of Moscow, the people's will, prosperous futures, and rights to freedom and truth have long been lost to war. But there lives a certain man with antique machine guns always in tow, beholden to no organization, whom they call a “Janitor”…

Sekine and Kagyu launched the manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in December 2022. Noboru Kannatsuki is credited with the character design. Square Enix shipped the fourth volume in December 2025.

SB Creative released a light novel adaptation by Kagyu in June 2023.

The anime adaptation of writer Kumo Kagyu and illustrator so-bin 's Blade & Bastard light novel series will premiere in 2027.

Kagyu ( Goblin Slayer! ) and so-bin ( Overlord ) launched the light novel series in December 2022. Drecom published the light novel series' sixth volume on March 10.

Makoto Fugetsu launched the manga adaptation on Drecom 's website in June 2023. Drecom published the manga's eighth volume also on March 10. Yen Press licensed the manga and released the fourth volume in English on June 23.

SB Creative published the first volume of Kumo Kagyu 's Goblin Slayer! dark fantasy novel series in February 2016, and Kōsuke Kurose ( The IDOLM@STER Neue Green for Dearly Stars ) launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Big Gangan in May 2016. Yen Press has licensed both Kumo Kagyu 's Goblin Slayer! novels and Kōsuke Kurose 's manga adaptation. The novels have inspired spinoff novels and manga series.

The first season premiered in Japan in October 2018, and Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles as it aired. Funimation also streamed the series with an English dub . The second season for the anime premiered in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed an English dub for the series.

title: 15 Years Later, A Sci-Fi Classic Returns With New Crunchyroll Dub Release
content:
It’s already been more than 15 years since Steins;Gate made its debut, but the anime has only just begun streaming the English dub. As the largest anime streaming platform around the world, Crunchyroll is home to over a thousand anime shows and movies. However, even though the platform’s library is vast, it doesn’t have everything fans would want. This also includes Dub releases for several classics that were added to the platform later on. Steins;Gate premiered in April 2011 and easily became one of the highest-rated psychological anime of all time. First released as a visual novel in 2009, the franchise would receive an anime adaptation in 2011 that helped spread the story all across the world.

However, with the dub unavailable for several years, it was more difficult for fans who are not used to watching anime in the subbed version. The official website of Crunchyroll confirmed on October 19th, 2026, that the anime has begun streaming the English dub of all 24 episodes. Crunchyroll also confirmed the voice actors of the main characters, including J. Michael Tatum as Rintaro, Trina Nishimura as Kurisu, Ashly Burch as Mayuri, Tyson Rinehart as Itaru, and Cherami Leigh as Suzuha.

Steins;Gate Returned With a New Release This Year

This summer Steins;Gate returned following a major delay, giving Rintaro Okabe another crack at travelling the timeline. On August 20th this year, Steins;Gate Re:Boot arrived on quite a few video game platforms. It serves as the full visual novel remake of the 2009 original game developed by MAGES and published by Spike Chunsoft. Originally set to release last year in 2025, the remake returned to the franchise’s roots, dropping the latest entry on Nintendo Switch & Switch 2, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Steam. The gameplay is set in the scenario of Steins;Gate Elite with faster pacing. All characters, backgrounds, and event stills have been redrawn from scratch, resulting in a major update compared to before. Compared to the Xbox 360 version, the number of event stills approximately doubled, and the background graphics have increased by approximately 1.2 times.

Steins;Gate Is One of the Most Unique Stories Ever

As a time-travel anime involving deep emotional connections and the consequences of such a power, Steins;Gate is highly addictive if you love a mystery anime and are deeply invested in it. At first, the prospect of time travel might seem like an exciting breakthrough, but it soon becomes clear through cycles of psychological torment that not everything is as it may seem. Despite his overwhelming enthusiasm, Rintaro Okabe, a self-proclaimed scientist, and his team have only managed to create a microwave that seemingly only has the odd ability to transform bananas into green goo.

At first, when he discovers that the microwave can be used for time travel itself, it seems like a groundbreaking scientific innovation, but things soon spiral out of control. As the situation turns from bad to worse, the discovery garners unwanted attention, and Okabe soon learns that time travel isn’t just a toy, but leads to dire, traumatizing consequences for both his loved ones and his own sanity. Realizing all too late the damage that’s been done, Okabe realizes he needs to move time itself to set things right.

title: K Manga Adds Shinobu Ohtaka's Geekrown Manga
content:
Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday that it is adding Shinobu Ohtaka 's Geekrown (also known as Geek and Crown ) manga on October 26.

The manga launches on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app on October 27. The original announcement teased that the story will center on a treasonous military officer in the middle of a succession crisis.

Ohtaka ( Magi ) launched the Orient manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in May 2018. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in February 2021. The manga entered its final arc in July 2023, and ended in October 2024. Kodansha published the manga's 22nd and final compiled book volume in November 2024. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and released the 20th volume on April 14.

The first cours (quarter of a year) of the manga's anime adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime, and also streamed an English dub . The anime's second cours premiered on TV Tokyo in July 2022, and covered the "Awajishima Gekitō-hen" (Fierce Battle at Awaji Island Arc) of the original manga. Crunchyroll also streamed the anime's second cours , and an English dub .

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime Reveals English Dub Cast, October 23 Debut
content:
The English dub cast includes:

• Rowan Gilvie as Satoko

• Kieran Flitton as Shinpei

• Jason Douglas as Mitsueda

• Ben Stegmair as Kotaro

• R Bruce Elliott as Jubei

• Jordan Colea as Miwako

• Chris Rager as Ozoe

The dub staff includes:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Samantha Herek

• Adaptation Supervisor: Macy Anne Johnson

• Adaptation: Matthew Greenbaum

• Adaptation Prep: Stevie Ray Krieger

• Voice Director: Caitlin Glass

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Wesley Coleman

• Mixer: Nathanael Harrison

The anime debuted on October 9 and airs on Fuji TV 's Noitamina programming block that airs on Fridays at 11:30 p.m. Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs.

The anime stars Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō. Additional cast members include Kent Itō as Kōtarō Ogawa and Kenjirō Tsuda as Mitsueda.

Takahiro Kamei (2022-2024's Urusei Yatsura ) is directing the anime at david production , and Yukiko Aikei ( Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere , Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop , Your Lie in April ) is designing the characters. Yūko Kakihara (2022-2024 Urusei Yatsura series, IRODUKU: The World in Colors , Blue Box ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and NOGRID is composing the music.

Iri performs the opening theme song "Period," and TOOBOE performs the anime's ending theme song "Yumegokochi" (Trance).

Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

Tachibana launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023, and Shogakukan published the 13th compiled book volume on October 19.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action television adaptation that is slated to debut in 2027.

title: One Piece Teases Jump Festa 2027 With New Update
content:
Shueisha is gearing up for one of the biggest events of the year, Jump Festa, which is always held toward the end of the year. With One Piece being one of the conglomerate’s biggest manga franchises, it has a major lineup planned. Now, as the event approaches, One Piece is sharing even more updates, with the latest featuring a special illustration that confirms several other details as well. Jump Festa was announced to take place on the December 19–20 weekend, but the schedule had yet to be unveiled. Now, it has finally been revealed, and One Piece confirms its grand stage.

One Piece announced through a new illustration featuring all the Straw Hats that its Super Stage will be the final one, with an extended session scheduled for December 20 , from 16:45 to 17:35 JST. It was also announced that all the voice actors of the Straw Hat crew will attend the event. One Piece is the only series receiving an extended Super Stage panel, while others, including Demon Slayer, are scheduled for the standard 30-minute slot. This is certainly good news for One Piece fans, and with a potentially major announcement in store for the series, the event could be truly grand.

One Piece Is Set to Steal the Show at Jump Festa 2027 With Special Announcements

There is a reason One Piece is the only franchise receiving an extended panel at Jump Festa 2027, and unsurprisingly, it is because the series has a lot of events to showcase. The One Piece anime already underwent a major change in its direction last year, but this year brought even more surprising news. While the 26-episode format will continue in 2027, Toei Animation also announced a canon movie titled One Piece Film: God Valley , depicting the chaotic God Valley flashback featured in the manga’s Elbaph arc.

This is a surprising yet exciting move for the franchise, as the God Valley incident is an important part of the manga that shouldn’t be treated lightly. Speaking of the manga, Jump Festa events also unveil the future of the series, and considering that One Piece is likely nearing the end of its Elbaph arc, the manga could reveal what lies ahead and how much of the story remains. However, these possibilities are still some way off, as the panel could also discuss Netflix’s highly anticipated The One Piece reboot, which has been in the works for some time. Netflix’s The One Piece is set to arrive in February 2027, and fans could get a new look and trailer as well.

While these three elements would be enough to highlight the franchise’s reach, One Piece still has another major project to showcase: Netflix’s live-action adaptation. Netflix has confirmed that the third season will arrive in 2027 , depicting the Battle of Alabasta arc. With so much to unveil, it is no wonder One Piece needs an extended panel at Jump Festa 2027. Fans have a lot to look forward to, and with all 10 Straw Hat voice actors also attending, this could be the biggest One Piece Super Stage in Jump Festa history.

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Streams Animated Trailer for Tokyo Revengers DLC Characters Mikey, Draken
content:
SNK began streaming on Thursday an animated trailer for its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game featuring the DLC characters Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime.

The company also streamed a trailer for the Nintendo Switch 2 version, which launched on Thursday alongside the crossover characters:

The game's official X/Twitter account shared two commemorative illustrations for the new releases.

Manjiro Sano and Ken Ryuguji joined the game as Season 3 DLC characters on Thursday. Aleks Le voices Manjiro Sano in English and Yuu Hayashi voices the character in Japanese. Sean Chiplock voices Ken Ryuguji in English and Masaya Fukunishi voices the character in Japanese.

Season 3 launched on July 23 with six characters joining the roster. Rick Strowd joined the game on July 23. Duck King launched on August 27. Kim Kaphwan joined the game's roster on September 24. The game will add Laocorn in November, as well as Reina in December.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. The game launched Andy Bogard as a playable character in June 2025, added Ken as a playable character in August 2025, introduced Joe Higashi as a playable character in October 2025, debuted Chun-Li in November 2025, and launched MR. BIG in December 2025.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for the game's Season Pass 2, launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci, professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.

Iri performs the opening theme song "Period," and TOOBOE performs the anime's ending theme song "Yumegokochi" (Trance).
Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.
Tachibana launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023, and Shogakukan published the 13th compiled book volume on October 19.
The manga is also inspiring a live-action television adaptation that is slated to debut in 2027.

title: Black Clover's ONE OR EIGHT to Perform in Manila
content:
Rising Japanese boy group ONE OR EIGHT is ready to take off with their bar-setting momentum to Manila with ONE OR EIGHT Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8– at Samsung Hall, SM Aura Premier, on October 23, 2026. ONE OR EIGHT performed the ending theme for the second season of Black Clover .

The new single marks the group’s first Japanese-language song. Inspired by protagonist Asta’s journey of moving forward despite being born without magic, “Yellow Brick Road” turns that struggle into a message about choosing your own path, finding strength in the people beside you, and continuing even when the road gets rough.

ONE OR EIGHT Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8– ticket sales are currently ongoing via Ticketmaster and the SOZO Live website. For more information, visit the ONE OR EIGHT Asia Tour website.

In addition, a member introduction , tour promo , snack challenge , merchandise, and event guide have also been released:

About ONE OR EIGHT & Their Music

ONE OR EIGHT comprises eight members: MIZUKI , NEO , REIA , RYOTA , SOUMA , TAKERU , TSUBASA, and YUGA . The group’s name is derived from the Japanese idiom “ichi ka bachi ka,” which expresses the idea of taking an all-or-nothing gamble. Together with their tagline “ BET ON YOURSELF,” the name reflects the members’ determination to pursue their dreams, challenge boundaries, and take their music to audiences around the world.

Since making their debut in August 2024, ONE OR EIGHT have quickly established themselves as one of Japan’s emerging global acts. Their track “TOKYO DRIFT” generated more than 200,000 pieces of user-generated content on TikTok and over 300 million views, while also entering the Mediabase Top 40 and setting a record for the most chart entries by a Japanese boy group. They were also named one of Nikkei Entertainment!’s 100 New Leading Artists, received Upcoming Dance & Vocal Group award at the MTV VMAJ 2025 in Japan, and were named New Artist of the Year at the 2025 Music Awards organized by China’s NetEase.

The group has also worked with internationally acclaimed creators, including Ryan Tedder, David Stewart, and Big Sean, expanding their musical horizons to connect Japanese music with a global audience. Ahead of their Southeast Asia showcases, ONE OR EIGHT will introduce a new chapter with their first EP “EN-GiNE” on September 16, 2026. The announcement is accompanied by a thoughtful message for the fans:

The title combines the Japanese word “EN” (縁), representing connection and fate, with “GENE,” symbolizing the new driving force created through the relationships the members have developed with one another and with fans around the world. Following “YANKEE SQUAT,” the group recently released “INVINCIBLE,” the second single dedicated to their fans known as 1DERZ from the upcoming EP. The track carries the message that no journey is taken alone, celebrating the trust, gratitude, and connection that have grown between ONE OR EIGHT and their supporters since their debut. With Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8-, the group brings this special opportunity to the fans in Southeast Asia to experience that connection in person.

The ONE OR EIGHT Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8- is organized by SOZO, a leading entertainment company connecting Japanese entertainment with audiences across Southeast Asia. Through its flagship platform, Anime Festival Asia (AFA), SOZO pioneered the region’s Anime, Comics, and Games scene. SOZO has also produced major live entertainment experiences for leading Japanese artists, including Ado, Eve, RADWIMPS , YOASOBI, and Yuuri.

title: Psyren TV Anime Casts Reiko Suzuki, Ayumu Murase
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced on Thursday that it has cast Reiko Suzuki as Elmore Tenjuin (pictured below on right) and Ayumu Murase as Van Tenjuin (left):

Global Stage Hollywood screened the world premiere for the second episode of the anime at the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival on October 3 at the Chinese Theater in Hollywood, California. The first episode also screened its West Coast premiere during the event. The manga's original creator Iwashiro was in attendance at the screening.

Katsumi Ono ( Symphogear AXZ , Symphogear G , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Naruto Shippūden , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! GX ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Akira Ōkuma ( Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ; Demon Lord, Retry! R ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Takashi Ōmama ( Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , I Parry Everything ), and Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses ).

CLAN QUEEN performs the opening theme song "Warning!!" Who-ya Extended performs the ending theme song "ICARUS."

REMOW describes the anime:

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psy ren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

REMOW stated the anime will fully adapt the manga through its conclusion.

Iwashiro serialized Psyren in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2007-2010. Viz Media released all 16 volumes in English from 2011 to 2014.

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press Licenses Uoto's 100 Meters, Goku Midnight Eye Manga for Release in 2027
content:
Mad Cave Studios' imprint Nakama Press announced on Thursday that it has licensed Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga, and will release the first two volumes in 2027. Nakama Press will release the manga's first volume on February 17 and the second volume on April 27. Additionally, Nakama Press licensed Buichi Terasawa 's Goku - Midnight Eye manga, and will release the first volume on March 2. Nakama Press also confirmed with ANN that the new release date for Samurai Pizza Cats , a new 200-page middle-grade comic inspired by the Samurai Pizza Cats ( Kyatto-Ninden Teyandee ) anime, is December 8. The comic was first announced for release on April 7 of this year.

The company shared a cover and pages in English for 100 Meters .

Nakama Press describes 100 Meters manga 's story:

In 100 Meters , Togashi, a naturally gifted sprinter, has always outrun everything around him—until he meets a rival who challenges not just his speed, but his understanding of what it means to win. As their paths continue to cross from childhood into adolescence, what begins as a simple race evolves into an intense, psychological rivalry. Driven by talent, obsession, and the desire to prove themselves, both runners are pushed to their limits both on and off the track.

Uoto ( Orb: On the Movements of the Earth ) launched the manga in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app in November 2018 as Uoto 's first series, and Kodansha published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume digitally in October 2019.

The manga's anime film adaptation premiered in Japan in September 2025. The film ranked #8 in its opening weekend, and earned 102,666,040 yen (about US$694,700) in its first three days. GKIDS screened the film in October 2025 in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . The film also screened in Los Angeles that October. The film won the runner-up award for Best Animated Film at the Florida Film Critics Circle Awards in 2025. Netflix began streaming the film with Japanese audio and English subtitles in December 2025.

Nakama Press describes Goku - Midnight Eye 's story:

After a brutal attack leaves him with a cybernetic eye, private investigator Goku gains the ability to hack any system with a glance. But in a world of high-tech crime and shadowy conspiracies, every answer comes at a cost—and the deeper he looks, the more dangerous the truth becomes. Goku, a hard-boiled private investigator in a near-future Tokyo where crime, corruption, and advanced technology collide, gains a powerful cybernetic eye that allows him to interface directly with computers. After a near-fatal encounter, he gains an edge in a world where information is the ultimate weapon. As he takes on dangerous cases that blur the line between human and machine, Goku is drawn deeper into a conspiracy that threatens to reshape the city itself.

Terasawa's three-volume manga originally launched in 1987. Yoshiaki Kawajiri directed the manga's anime adaptation at Madhouse , and Terasawa and Ryūzō Nakanishi wrote the script. The OVA released in 1989 and a sequel also released in 1989. Discotek released both OVAs on DVD in 2017. Discotek then released Goku - Midnight Eye on Blu-ray Disc under the title Midnight Eye Goku in 2023. The release marked the first Blu-ray Disc release of the OVA anywhere in the world. The release included two dubs: one from Urban Vision and one from Manga UK .

Update: Added Goku - Midnight Eye to headline.
